items.heading: Did you know?
items.content:
Notarization is more than placing a signature and seal on a document. A New York Notary Public performs specific acts such as verifying identity, taking acknowledgments, administering oaths or affirmations, and witnessing signatures when required.

The Notary Giant® performs these services with accuracy, confidentiality, and strict adherence to New York State requirements.

items.heading: Fun fact
items.content: New York notaries are authorized to witness signatures on a variety of legal documents, including wills, deeds, and powers of attorney. They play a crucial role in ensuring the validity of these important papers.

items.heading: Quick tip
items.content: Before meeting with a Notary Public, ensure you have a valid ID with you. This will help streamline the verification process and make the notarization of your documents easier and more efficient.
